defects.what: Large pseudo-letters like 'PRI' plus smaller glyphs are carved into the ash in the foreground, instead of one repeated letter L or a blank surface.
Both open pages of the book are covered in clearly visible Chinese/Japanese-style pseudo-characters around the circle drawing.
The floating letterhead is filled with dense Japanese-style pseudo-text and a signature-like mark, and only a bare triangle stands in for the logo.
The two large papers held up in the foreground show rows of CJK-style pseudo-characters.
The street behind the boy is a Japanese shopping street with vertical signboards of kanji-like glyphs, not a Philippine sidewalk.
The engraving sits inside a black-bordered frame on a white margin, with a broken second panel sticking out on the right edge.
A human face with eyes, nose and mouth appears inside the tattoo lattice on the forearm.
The black dog at the bottom has two heads on one body: one looks right with an upright ear and another at lower left has its tongue out.
The dog on the ledge is a brown-and-white collie type with a separate fox-like head beside it, not black Usman with a red kerchief.
The young man beside Usman is a blond boy in a white outfit with no topknot, so he does not read as Indio.
Several watch dials carry pseudo-text labels, and some dials show small faces and eyes painted in them.
The open books and scrolls on the shelf show small rows of pseudo-text lines.
The golden squiggle at the centre of the parchment reads as the characters '2l2'.
The three depths are boxed by wooden beams into stacked rectangles that read like comic panels, with a big anime face in the top box.
The young man on the right has no topknot and wears a white collared shirt instead of the episode's grey tee.
The young man has no topknot and wears a light blue collared shirt, and his tattoos are floral rather than indigo geometric.
The young man being tugged has no topknot and wears a navy zip jacket instead of the grey tee.
